title: Each sign’s slow morning.
caption: Taurus gets breakfast in bed, then second breakfast. Virgo has one thing on the to-do list: rest. Capricorn turns off the alarm and the guilt. Which slow morning is yours? Send this to someone who needs a lie-in.
